_comment: INSPECTRA Rule Library — Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
_status: STUB — Rules are defined here for future implementation. No rule engine reads this file yet.

rules.name: Product Name Declaration
rules.description: Every package shall bear the name of the commodity.

rules.name: Net Quantity Declaration
rules.description: Every package shall declare net quantity in standard units.

rules.name: Manufacturer Name & Address
rules.description: Name and complete address of the manufacturer or packer shall be declared.

rules.name: Month and Year of Manufacture
rules.description: Month and year in which commodity is manufactured or packed shall be declared.

rules.name: MRP Declaration
rules.description: Every package shall carry MRP inclusive of all taxes.

rules.name: Consumer Care Information
rules.description: Consumer care contact details shall be declared.
